name: Kevin Lainez
office: City of Commerce, Member of the City Council

items.text: Kevin Lainez is a Commerce city councilmember and mayor, elected in 2022. He previously chaired the Planning Commission and vice-chaired the Traffic Commission. He serves on the Gateway Cities Council of Governments board.

sentences.text: Kevin Lainez is a Commerce city councilmember and mayor, elected in 2022.
He previously chaired the Planning Commission and vice-chaired the Traffic Commission.
He serves on the Gateway Cities Council of Governments board.

items.text: He backed a sales tax increase to offset revenue losses from a state blackjack ban, stating it could recoup at least $4.5 million. In August 2026, he supported a 45-day council moratorium on data centers to study their impacts. His campaign says he helped launch a small business assistance program and pushed for road repairs. He also highlights creating a green building ordinance and enhancing rent subsidies for low-income seniors and veterans.
